doc.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23

chapter: Photo session: wagons, parades and goodbyes
title: Carnival parade contracts and Nick's brief time
summary: Laine says he played all the carnival parades and balls under Braun and Moss contracts, and La Rocca played with him but not much.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Did you use saxophone very much in your early bands?
No.
Need a piano. Need a piano. Where's that? Uh-oh. It looks like somebody borrowed it off you and took a... Somebody reproduced that in a paper or something. A reproduction on that, yeah.
I know this is on Canal and Royal.
It looks like a nice Mardi Gras parade.
Yes, yes.
Did you play many of those, Jack?
Everyone put in there that was given. All the parades, yeah.
All the carnival parades he had.
Everyone that was given.
Yeah.
Yeah. When Captain Braun had the contract for years and years, played. Then... Benny Moss. Benny Moss. Benny Moss got it. Yeah. I played. And some other fella got it. Nice-hazard guy got it.
Ooh, who are these things for filth?
I played. Everyone up until the war. Ooh. Ooh. Played them all. Day and night. You ever have... Played the balls, too.
You ever had Nick play with you on the Mardi Gras parade? No.
Never did play with you on the Mardi Gras parade? I had Nick the year that he sent Brunus, yes.
Oh, I see, yeah. He was going to play, but he didn't play. Huh? He was going to play, but he missed it.

He was going to play, but he didn't. He didn't. He sent Brunus his place. Yeah, yeah. Yeah. But what year would that be, Jack? Well, you see, I'd like to answer these questions, but I want to be sure before I do so. Yeah. Now, I really can't tell, but it's been a many year ago. That I can tell you.
Yeah.
That I can tell you. It's been a mentally long, very long time ago.
Oh, it's...
About how many years did Nick play with you, Jack? Oh, not very much. Not many years? No. No. Not very much, no.
